question: Why is this great lord not considered the material cause constituted by Māyā?
premises: Lord Ananta has been identified as the agitator.
An agitator is distinct from the material cause.
Māyā functions as the material cause in this context.
inference: Therefore this great lord is not the material cause that is Māyā.
plain_english: Therefore this great lord is likewise not the material cause that is Māyā.
